added.title: Café Restaurant Amsterdam
added.description: Big, lively brasserie in a 1900 water-pumping hall, serving all-day classics and seafood platters.

added.title: BAK
added.description: Seasonal, local tasting menu on the third floor of a harbour warehouse looking out over the IJ.

added.title: Hotel de Goudfazant
added.description: Not a hotel: a French-leaning three-course menu served in a vast old warehouse by the IJ.

added.title: Troef

added.title: Restaurant Blauw

added.title: Choux

added.title: Alba

added.title: Helling 7

added.title: Vinkeles

added.title: MOS

added.title: Lars Amsterdam

added.title: Restaurant Europa

added.title: Toscanini

added.title: Wilde Zwijnen

added.description: Snug French wine café with a daily three- or four-course bistro menu and more than 300 French bottles.

added.title: Roest

added.title: Vermeer

added.title: Daalder

added.title: Gebr. Hartering
added.description: Busy brothers-run bistro serving a daily-changing table d'hôte menu from small local suppliers.

added.title: Rijsel
added.description: Bustling French-Flemish bistro in a former domestic-science school, at fair prices.

added.title: VanOost
added.description: Fine dining in a lofty 1908 university building, blending French technique with Japanese flavours.

added.title: De Mark
added.description: Wood-fired, vegetable-led seasonal cooking in a dike-side hotel in Durgerdam village.
